description: Broker tool: classifies a mortgage as insured, insurable or uninsurable (purchase, renewal, switch, refinance) with reasons, then GDS/TDS in each category at its rate. Renewals depend on whether a premium was paid at origination.

annualIncome.description: Household gross annual income in CAD (for GDS/TDS)

condoFeesMonthly.description: Monthly condo fees in CAD (50% counted)

equityTakeout.description: Refinance only: taking equity out / raising the loan

fthbOrNewBuild.description: First-time buyer or new construction (30-yr insured)

homeValue.description: Home value (or purchase price) in CAD

monthlyDebts.description: Other monthly debt payments in CAD

mortgageAmount.description: Mortgage amount / outstanding balance in CAD

premiumPaid.description: Was a borrower-paid insurance premium paid originally?

qualifyingMode.description: Qualify at the stress-test rate or at the contract rate

rateInsuredPct.description: Insured rate, % (illustrative default — pass the lender's)

name: insured_insurable_uninsured
title: Insured vs Insurable vs Uninsurable Mortgage Check
